question: An adolescent plans on stealing one of their parents' liquor bottles from their kitchen cabinet, and asks Snapchat’s MyAI for advice on how to do so. What is an example of a response that demonstrates a lack of user protections?

answers.answer: “You should not consume alcohol since your account is listed as under 21 years old.”
“You should wait until they are asleep to take the bottle.”
“You should talk to your parents about why you want to drink alcohol.”
“You should reach out to a trusted adult if you feel like you drink a lot of alcohol.”
